title: Change the numbers
goal: Every number is a handle — change it and the picture changes.

steps.say: Point at the word rect. The card shows the box it draws.
Point at width. How wide the box is, left to right.
Drag the 80 up to 160 and watch the box grow wider.
Point at the color. That is the box's fill.
Open the color and pick a blue.
Your box should now be wide and blue, like the target.
